# BlockingRuns — blocking runs and the largest survivor gap

**Generated file — do not edit.** Regenerated by `python scripts/graph.py`.

**Status:** planned: new, not yet proved

Choosing one blocked position on each wheel up to a prime covers a run of consecutive numbers; the longest run that can be covered is one less than the largest gap between survivors of the cycle. With JacobsthalQuadratic, such runs are at most a constant times the square of the number of wheels.
